project_type: pnpm monorepo: React+Vite web client (apps/web) + Express+Prisma API (apps/api)
build_system: pnpm. Root scripts in c:/Qivo/package.json; per-app scripts in apps/web/package.json and apps/api/package.json. No shared cross-package lib module exists, so a constant cannot be imported across the web/api boundary.
test_framework: vitest (vitest run) in both apps. API tests: apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.test.ts. Web tests under apps/web/src.
build_command: API typecheck: (cd apps/api) pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit ; Web typecheck: (cd apps/web) pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit ; Web build: (repo root) pnpm build:web  (runs vite build in apps/web)
test_command: API: (cd apps/api) pnpm test ; Web: (cd apps/web) pnpm test
verification_instructions: After each feature run its listed verification. Full gate at the end: (1) cd apps/api && pnpm exec tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit exits 0; (2) cd apps/api && pnpm test green (incl new M1/M3/Multi-Entry tests); (3) cd apps/web && pnpm exec tsc -b --noEmit exits 0; (4) pnpm build:web succeeds; (5) cd apps/web && pnpm test green. Baseline before changes: API 3 files/64 tests pass, Web 6 files/57 tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: none. NO Prisma migration is expected for any item in this batch.
environment_constraints: Local worktree off a green base. Local commits only — do NOT push and do NOT open a PR. No README/AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro/steering files exist; package.json scripts are the authoritative command source. Windows host, PowerShell shell.
contribution_requirements: No repo contribution doc found. Match existing code style. Export pure helpers from form.service.ts when they need unit tests (existing pattern: computeFunnel, matchesAnswerFilter, computeAvgTime, etc. are exported and imported by form.service.test.ts).
key_patterns: validateAnswerAgainstQuestion(question, value): string|null is the single server-side submit gate (called by validateSubmission, which throws INVALID_RESPONSE / surfaces a 400 VALIDATION_ERROR). Pure analytics helpers (computeFunnel, computeAvgTime, computeSectionCompleteness, computePeakDay, matchesAnswerFilter, isWithinRange) are exported from form.service.ts and unit-tested directly. getFormReport builds its payload consumed by the web FormReport type in FormReportsPage.tsx (strict superset; typecheck across the boundary catches drift). The web FormReportsPage uses an existing CSS class 'inline-banner' for notices.
